name: flezha/sdk
description: The Flezha PHP SDK: a poll host over flz_core's C ABI, through ext-ffi.

suggest.ext-swoole: ^6.0, built against a ZTS PHP with --enable-swoole-thread: provides Swoole\Thread, which SwooleExecutor runs the poll loop on. Not required — SyncExecutor needs no extension beyond ext-ffi.
